summary: Iteration 9 (v2 batch): Full backend + frontend E2E pass. Backend 82/82 pytest green (66 pre-existing + 16 NEW v2 tests in test_v2_features.py covering catalog, complaints, post-a-job credit gating, chat lifecycle applied→hired→completed, two-way reviews with dup/rating validation, /pros/{id} profile). Frontend flows on mobile viewport 390x844: (1) user-chip on landing → /profile shows hero + all 6 menu rows (profile-chats/-map/-categories/-plans/-support/-legal) + profile-logout-btn. (2) Support screen: FAQ accordion (faq-0 expands), complaint form submits via POST /api/complaints → complaint-sent card visible. (3) Legal screen renders Terms/Privacy/Refund sections (all three keywords present). (4) Categories screen loads /api/catalog (9 categories · 148 services), expanding cat-graphics-design and tapping sub-logo-design routes to /freelancer/jobs?q=Logo+Design with search-input prefilled ('Logo Design') and filtered feed shown. (5) Employer screen: lead-card-0 tap navigates to /pro/{id} showing pro-hero with name Rohan Verma, RATING 4.9, JOBS DONE 86, CATEGORY, PORTFOLIO link, SKILLS & TOOLS chips, REVIEWS section. (6) POST A JOB (post-job-btn) → /employer/post-job form with company/title/category/pay/area/description → submit triggers Razorpay iframe (Total Amount ₹299 — correct Single Post amount); app-level copy 'Razorpay Test Mode · UPI (GPay/PhonePe), cards & netbanking' shown under submit; the initial Razorpay iframe screen shows contact form first (payment method selector renders AFTER mobile entry — expected). (7) CHAT LIFECYCLE E2E: seeded verified freelancer (TEST_v2 ChatUser, aadhaar 432112345678) applied to cjob-916ea90b → conversation f3c2c622..., opened /chat/{id}?role=employer → HIRE PRO → MARK COMPLETED → RATE PRO opens review-modal → star-5 + text + review-submit-btn → chat-reviewed-pill visible; switched to freelancer view same thread → RATE EMPLOYER → 4⭐ submit → chat-reviewed-pill visible; both reviews confirmed persisted via GET /api/reviews (subject_type freelancer:5⭐ and company:4⭐). (8) Regression Razorpay ₹199 employer unlock: unlock-cta-btn → pay-confirm-btn → iframe Total Amount ₹199 confirmed. Only console noise: React 19 element.ref warning + props.pointerEvents deprecation (both from @gorhom/bottom-sheet, non-blocking).

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking React 19 warning: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — emitted from bottom-sheet on employer/freelancer screens. Known upstream, safe to ignore.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1277 lines with 8 domains (leads, freelancer onboarding, jobs feed, apply quota, plans, auth, chat, map, reviews, post-job, complaints, catalog). Strongly recommend splitting into APIRouter modules (auth_router, chat_router, reviews_router, jobs_router, catalog_router) — file exceeds the 700-line guideline by ~80%.
Chat lifecycle uses simple state-machine {applied→hired→completed} — no rollback/cancel path exists; consider adding cancel/no-show status before catalog scale-up.

post-job endpoint (POST /api/employer/jobs) uses _post_credits() based on plan_purchases collection; this correctly grants 1 credit for single-post and 5 for starter-bundle. Note that jobs feed at /api/jobs merges custom_jobs first, so newly-posted appear at top — verified programmatically (job cjob-916ea90b was at rank 3 after 3 fresh posts in this run).

Complaints endpoint stores to db.complaints and returns support_email — but does NOT actually send an email; the frontend uses a mailto link only. Confirmed MOCKED per task note; add SES/SMTP integration before prod.
MongoDB _id excluded correctly across all reads (chats, reviews, complaints, custom_jobs, plan_purchases). Good.
